data.title: Rejected-before works on a journal one day old, and on ours again
data.description: The onboarding prototype showed the prompt hook silent on a fresh journal: 'should we move orders to MongoDB?' against 'Postgres, not MongoDB' rejected 'MongoDB'. Measuring the KAD-61 set as a test found the rule had drifted on this repository's journal to 4 of 10 named and 3 false alarms. Read only the alternative's name, put a title's 'not X' on X's side, weigh the choice by its title.
